Analysis
Business Security Test consists of three main parts: the Real-World Protection Test that
mimics online malware attacks, the Malware Protection Test where the malware enters
the system from outside the internet (for example by USB), and the Performance Test
that looks at the impact on the system's performance.
Business Security Test 2021 (August - November): Real-World Protection Rate
99.8%
Microsoft Defender Antivirus has scored consistently high in Real-World Protection
Rates over the past year, with 99.8% in the latest test.
